```{=html}
<!-- Navbar -->
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- Page content -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card" style="max-width: 480px;">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">
    <h2>I am a...</h2>
    <p class="auth-subtitle">Choose how you would like to continue</p>

    <div class="role-buttons">
      <a href="login-student.html" class="role-btn role-btn-primary">
        <span class="role-btn-title">Registered Student</span>
        <span class="role-btn-desc">Log in with your username</span>
      </a>

      <a href="login-teacher.html" class="role-btn role-btn-primary">
        <span class="role-btn-title">Registered Teacher</span>
        <span class="role-btn-desc">Log in with your email and password</span>
      </a>

      <a href="#" id="guestBtn" class="role-btn role-btn-guest">
        <span class="role-btn-title">Continue as Guest</span>
        <span class="role-btn-desc">Browse modules without an account</span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById('guestBtn').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  sessionStorage.setItem('aaic_guest', 'true');
  window.location.href = 'guest-hub.html';
});
</script>
```
